title: Coupon Master
tagline: A little paper. A clever order. A very small bill.
moveTip: Double-click to queue · Drag to move · Q/E rotate
ready: The shopping list is ready. Take your time.
failed: The bill is still above zero.
nextTransaction: Your bill and play order carry over. Adjust them or play again.
noSpace: That coupon does not fit. Rearrange or sell one.
shopTip: Credit is allowed. Make room before buying.
sold: A little more room. A little more cash.
help1: Reach $0 or less in three transactions. A negative bill earns cash back. After the last transaction, pay any balance from your budget; you lose if you cannot cover it.
help2: Queue up to five coupons, then PLAY. They apply left to right. Order and bill carry over between transactions. Empty categories cannot be discounted.
help3: Drag to arrange the 7 × 3 book, or select a coupon then a cell. Q / E rotates; right-click queues a coupon.
help4: Buy or sell at the exchange between days. Credit is allowed. Build combinations that fit your book and finish 30 days.
d.pantry25: Reduce meat and dry goods by 25%.
d.bulk: Multiply the next numeric coupon by 1.5. Bulk stamps stack.
d.day: Add one day to this shopping trip.
d.meatswap: Swap meat and dry goods amounts.
d.dryswap: Swap dry goods and dairy amounts.
paid: The remaining bill was paid from your budget.
